scientific_integrity: The finite-shift equivalence is proved from explicit inequalities and unique factorization. The prime-pair counting corollary invokes a standard unconditional Selberg sieve bound, identified separately. Finite verification is supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The effective threshold is conservative and depends on the fixed initial prime set. The exceptional set has an upper bound but no claimed sharp asymptotic; priority remains subject to an independent literature review.
title: Finite shifted-prime obstructions to minimum-product prime partitions
